title: Glowing wristwatch
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- watch strap top -->
  <rect x='40' y='6' width='20' height='22' rx='6' fill='#7b3fa0'/>
  <!-- strap holes -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='2' fill='#c98ef0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='20' r='2' fill='#c98ef0'/>
  <!-- watch case -->
  <rect x='28' y='26' width='44' height='48' rx='12' fill='#e8c33a'/>
  <!-- case inner bezel -->
  <rect x='33' y='31' width='34' height='38' rx='9' fill='#b8912a'/>
  <!-- glowing screen -->
  <rect x='36' y='34' width='28' height='32' rx='7' fill='#0b1f3a'/>
  <!-- screen glow -->
  <rect x='36' y='34' width='28' height='32' rx='7' fill='#38f0c8' opacity='0.14'/>
  <!-- hands: hour -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='42' width='3' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#38f0c8'/>
  <!-- minute hand -->
  <rect x='50' y='46' width='10' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#a8ffe8'/>
  <!-- center dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- hour ticks -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='1.4' fill='#7df5dd'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='62' r='1.4' fill='#7df5dd'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='50' r='1.4' fill='#7df5dd'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='50' r='1.4' fill='#7df5dd'/>
  <!-- crown -->
  <rect x='72' y='46' width='6' height='8' rx='3' fill='#f6e08a'/>
  <!-- watch strap bottom -->
  <rect x='40' y='72' width='20' height='22' rx='6' fill='#7b3fa0'/>
  <!-- strap holes bottom -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='2' fill='#c98ef0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='89' r='2' fill='#c98ef0'/>
</svg>
